question: Which inputs do we need from a client requesting a mortgage?
note: Fictional bank and policy. The assistant's answers for each setting were generated once with an LLM (Claude) and saved for this class, so everyone sees the same results.

1.title: Lending policy p. 4 · Identity & income
1.text: Applicants provide a valid passport or ID card and a certificate of residence. Employed applicants submit their last three salary statements and the most recent tax return.

2.title: Lending policy p. 7 · Creditworthiness
2.text: Every applicant provides an extract from the debt enforcement register, not older than three months, and completes the signed Lakeside self-disclosure form HB-12.

3.title: Lending policy p. 9 · Own funds
3.text: At least 20% of the purchase price comes from own funds, of which at most 10% may come from pension fund (2nd pillar) assets. Proof: bank statements or a pension fund confirmation.

4.title: Lending policy p. 12 · Property
4.text: Required for the property: the purchase agreement (signed or draft), a recent land register extract and a valuation by a Lakeside-approved valuer.

a.text: A valid passport or ID card and a certificate of residence

b.text: Your last three salary statements and the most recent tax return

c.text: An extract from the debt enforcement register, not older than three months

d.text: The signed Lakeside self-disclosure form HB-12

e.text: Proof of own funds: at least 20% of the price, at most 10% from pension assets

f.text: The purchase agreement and a recent land register extract

g.text: A valuation by a Lakeside-approved valuer

answer.text: A valid passport or ID card
Recent salary statements and your tax return
An extract from the debt enforcement register
Proof of own funds, usually at least 20% of the price, at most 10% from pension assets
The purchase agreement and a land register extract

all.label: Remove all sources (no policy at all)

answer.text: A valid passport or ID card
Recent salary statements and your tax return
An extract from the debt enforcement register
Proof of own funds, usually at least 20% of the price, at most 10% from pension assets
The purchase agreement and a land register extract

extra: Proof of building insurance for the property

a.detail: Any LLM knows you need an ID. Only the certificate of residence came from [1].

b.detail: Salary statements and tax return are standard. Only 'the last three' came from [1].

c.detail: The debt enforcement extract is standard Swiss practice. Only 'not older than three months' came from [2].

d.detail: Form HB-12 exists only in our policy. Remove [2] and it disappears.

e.detail: 20% own funds and max. 10% from the 2nd pillar are standard Swiss rules. The answer barely changes without [3].

f.detail: Purchase agreement and land register extract are standard. Survives without [4].

g.detail: A valuation is standard; 'Lakeside-approved valuer' came from [4].
